name: Druidcraft
summary: Small nature magic: forecast the weather, make a bud bloom, a harmless sensory effect, or light/snuff a flame.
text: Choose one of these effects within range. Weather Sensor: a Tiny, harmless sensory display (for example a golden orb for clear skies, a little cloud for rain, or drifting snowflakes for snow) forecasts the weather at your location for the next 24 hours; it lasts 1 round. Bloom: a flower, seed pod or leaf bud instantly opens. Sensory Effect: a harmless sensation such as falling leaves, tiny phantom fairies, a soft breeze, an animal sound or a faint skunk smell, filling no more than a 5-foot Cube. Fire Play: light or put out a candle, a torch or a campfire.
